translations.web: So is he who goes in to his neighbor’s wife. Whoever touches her will not be unpunished.
translations.bsb: So is he who sleeps with another man’s wife; no one who touches her will go unpunished.
translations.kjv: So he that goeth in to his neighbour's wife; whosoever toucheth her shall not be innocent.
translations.asv: So he that goeth in to his neighbor's wife; Whosoever toucheth her shall not be unpunished.
